title: Russian admiral: the phenomenon's reality isn't in question

tellings.quote: Russia and I remember sitting down with this Admiral and he said to my interpreter he's like look if you're here to ask me whether or not the phenomenon is real the door is right over there

plain: Sometime in the 1990s, a Russian admiral told a visiting investigator that whether UFOs exist was not even up for discussion: if you are here to ask me whether the phenomenon is real, he said through an interpreter, "the door is right over there." The UFO investigator James Fox tells Michels this from his own experience, as the man who sat down with the admiral. If the story holds, it means a senior Russian military officer took the phenomenon's reality as settled.
